(Japanese: '''チョータ''' ''Chōta'') is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and a [[character of the day]] who was set to appear in [[AG101 (unaired)]].

Chōta lives on Jojo Island with his {{p|Barboach}}. He is seen trying to calm a group of {{p|Whiscash}}, suggesting he is kind and likes Pokémon.
